list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Changelog 3.1.1
- Added optional Create compatibility. When Create is installed, Unearthed generates minecraft:andesite with the same 14 veins of size 33 per chunk and height range as vanilla gravel. - Added the enable_create_andesite_reserve common-config option, enabled by default. It can be disabled by pack authors. - Added language files for German, Spanish (Spain and Mexico), Brazilian Portuguese, French, Polish, Japanese, Korean, and Turkish. - Added localized resource keys for the common-config categories and options. - Restored the Gradle wrapper files so the project can be built with gradlew / gradlew.bat. - Migrated all bundled crafting, smelting, blasting, and stonecutting recipes to the Minecraft 1.21.1 result format. The recipes now load at runtime instead of being discarded as malformed data. - Made enable_regolith_to_dirt_recipe actually control the regolith-to-dirt recipe through a NeoForge recipe condition. - Made disable_all stop the stone-replacer world-generation feature as intended. - Removed references to non-existent unearthed:iron_ore and unearthed:gold_ore items from item tags. - Restored the original Hyle base and deep-layer values for the default, limestone, sedimentary, and vanilla regions. In particular, grey limestone is no longer the base stone of every sedimentary region. - Registered the deep-rock replacer in Overworld generation and constrained it to Y=-1 and below. Deep rocks and their ore variants now generate without overwriting surface strata. - Completed the missing entries in British English, Ukrainian, and Simplified Chinese. - Normalized all 14 language files to the same 535 keys and removed obsolete localization entries. - Documented the Create and regolith configuration behavior in the README. - Create andesite now generates after the stone replacer and can replace natural Unearthed rock types, keeping its gravel-equivalent frequency stable.
Compatibility Notes - This release does not add a required Create dependency. The andesite reserve activates only when Create is present. - Existing terrain remains unchanged. Create andesite generation applies only to chunks generated after installing this version.
